question: Knowing what is known at the review date, would we write materially different protections for this borrower?
updated_summary: Evidence through the August 6, 2024 press release shows no new developments that would require tightening, loosening, or adding protections; the existing covenants already capture the Amazon Break Fee terms and financial reporting obligations.
updated_reasons: All observed events (merger termination, break‑fee receipt, inventory/cash changes) are already addressed by the existing covenant package; no new risk coverage, monitoring needs, or behavioral permissions emerge.
reading: Changes listed as evidence-attributable appear only when the new reports are supplied. Changes also present in the control reflect pre-existing gaps or model drafting preference, not newly emerging drift. One run of each; repeat-run stability is not yet measured.
